edges.description: An episode of stress-provoked deterioration may itself progress to unexplained coma, which in the original series followed infections and minor head traumas.

Fever activates the same integrated stress response that the eIF2B defect already deregulates, so the exposure amplifies an ISR that is abnormal at baseline. EXACERBATES rather than TRIGGERS: the genetic defect, not the infection, establishes the deregulated state.
The episode of acute decline itself does not occur without a stressor, so the exposure initiates it rather than amplifying it; the intermediate is the ISR node above.
Head trauma is one of the physiological stressors that precipitates an episode of rapid neurological deterioration on top of the chronic progressive course.

Inhalation anaesthetics act on the same integrated stress response that the eIF2B defect already deregulates, so the exposure pushes an already-abnormal ISR further and is the proposed route by which anaesthesia provokes acute decline.

VWM white matter-like astrocytes inhibit oligodendrocyte maturation in coculture, the astrocyte-to-oligodendrocyte axis the node describes, and the defect is confined to the white matter-like subtype.
edges.limitations: Two-dimensional cultures from two human donors with EIF2B5 mutations only; there is no myelinating tissue, so white matter loss itself is not observed. The white matter-like identity is induced by culture conditions (CNTF) rather than by anatomical origin.

The guideline recommends considering non-ISR-activating alternatives such as propofol.

nodes.description: Disease-modifying approaches target the deregulated integrated stress response. The eIF2B activator ISRIB normalized ISR mRNA markers and ameliorated neuropathology in VWM mice, and the FDA-approved alpha2-agonist guanabenz, which modulates eIF2 phosphorylation/eIF2B activity, improved Bergmann glia and cerebellar myelin pathology in VWM mice. Guanabenz has since been taken into humans: a single-arm phase 1/2 trial in 33 children with early-childhood-onset VWM reported a significantly lower risk of losing the ability to walk with support than in 66 matched untreated historical controls, at the cost of a substantial adverse-event burden dominated by transient hallucinations. The comparison was non-randomised and the authors call for confirmation in a long-term extension study, so guanabenz is an investigational therapy with the first human efficacy signal rather than an established one. The direct eIF2B activator fosigotifator (ABBV-CLS-7262) is in an ongoing open-label phase 1b/2 study. See the clinical_trials block.

nodes.description: Biallelic pathogenic variants in EIF2B1-EIF2B5 partially reduce the guanine nucleotide exchange activity of eIF2B, the five-subunit GEF that recycles inactive eIF2-GDP to active eIF2-GTP to permit translation initiation. eIF2B has an essential housekeeping role in translation and in its regulation during stress, yet the white matter (and ovaries) are selectively vulnerable.

evidence.reference_title: Vanishing white matter.
evidence.snippet: "Vanishing white matter" (VWM) is a leukodystrophy caused by autosomal recessive pathogenic variants in the genes encoding the subunits of eukaryotic initiation factor 2B (eIF2B).

nodes.description: The first vertebrate EIF2B3 model, made by CRISPR deletion in the zebrafish eif2b3 ortholog. Mutants show defects in myelin development and glial differentiation and raised ISR gene expression, together with ectopic angiogenesis and increased VEGF expression that a VEGF receptor inhibitor reduced. The authors used the line to test 18 reported human EIF2B3 variants and a novel p.Leu168Pro variant. Ectopic angiogenesis has no corresponding node in this entry and is not linked.

evidence.reference_title: Eif2b3 mutants recapitulate phenotypes of vanishing white matter disease and validate novel disease alleles in zebrafish.
evidence.snippet: Using CRISPR, we generated two mutant alleles in zebrafish eif2b3, 10- and 16-bp deletions, respectively.

nodes.description: CRISPR-generated eif2b5 mutant zebrafish, the homozygous-viable allele of the series in Keefe et al. 2020. Homozygotes survive to adulthood but are smaller, show increased CNS apoptosis including apoptotic oligodendrocyte precursor cells in the hindbrain, baseline ISR activation, and thinner myelin sheaths with reduced brain volume as adults. The same paper's more severe alleles (eif2b5 zc102, eif2b2 sa17223) die by about 10 days post fertilization. Keefe et al. found no swimming deficit in zc103 homozygotes at 5 days post fertilization, whereas the later lithium study reports reduced distance moved, moving time and velocity at 7 days.

nodes.description: Lithium, an indirect eIF2B activator through GSK3-beta inhibition, was screened first in eif2b5 zc103 mutant zebrafish, where it improved swimming, and then in 2b4he2b5ho mice, where it did not help (see the mouse lithium entry above). The authors used the zebrafish as a rapid screening platform and conclude lithium is not a candidate for further development in VWM.
